lines.text: You earned eighty-five thousand dollars. So why does it feel like you keep so little?
Federal tax, Social Security, Medicare, state tax. They all take a slice before the money reaches you.
That's why I built Dolidob: free calculators that show exactly where every dollar goes.
Pick your state on the map and see your take-home pay in seconds. It uses 2026 rules for all fifty states and D.C., even city taxes like New York City.
See the full breakdown: federal tax, Social Security and Medicare, state tax, and what is left for you, every year and every month.
And it's not just paychecks. There are more than twenty calculators for mortgages, debt payoff, 401(k) and more.
Prefer chat? Our free Telegram bot does it in one message.
Try it with your own numbers at dolidob dot com. Estimates only, not tax advice.
